text:
Maya (PM): uploaded new mocks for the autoscale & capacity control panel — focus on min/max, burst modal, and the SLO slider. link: https://figma.redwood/infer/autoscale-v3 :eyes: Sam (Design): looked! really like the compact pool selector. question: should burst be an explicit toggle or an inline slider? burst modal felt heavy in the previous version. Kevin (Eng): from runtime side, burst as a toggle + numeric burst quota is easiest to map to GPU pool reservations. sliders are fine but need to clamp values server-side and show estimated cost. Priya (Accessibility): main concerns: keyboard order, visible focus for the mini-stepper, and screen-reader announcements when SLO slider changes effectiveness. also color contrast for the red guardrail badge. Maya (PM): proposal: inline compact stepper for min/max (with +/- buttons), a small "Burst" pill next to pool that opens a lightweight flyout for quota and duration. SLO slider stays in the header with a help tooltip. thoughts? Sam (Design): +1 to flyout (less modal friction). For the stepper: show unit label "GPUs" and use 1/step increments by default, but allow fractional (0.5) when pool supports fractional slots. micro-proposal for UI copy: min -> "minimum reserved", max -> "burst cap" feels confusing — maybe keep min/max but surface a short explainer line. Kevin (Eng): implementational note: fractional GPUs only available on certain pool types; will need to gray out fractional option for others. Also prefer explicit "Apply" in flyout so we can validate cost before commit. on server: validate min <= max and burstQuota + currentReserved <= poolCapacity. Priya (Accessibility): for screen readers, when user increases SLO slider we should announce: "SLO target updated to 99% — may increase cost by ~20%". Use an aria-live region for that. Example: `
SLO updated
` Sam (Design): good call. Also thinking about color: SLO slider uses green/orange/red states. we need a patterned indicator for color-blind users and an icon (shield/warning) with accessible label. Liam (Data): can we show a tiny projected cost delta inline when changing min/max? even a ballpark $/hr would help product folks. we can backfill with 30-day average token distribution. Maya (PM): yes — show an inline estimator under the stepper: "Est. cost: $7.40/hr (↑15%)" and make it clickable to expand a brief breakdown. default text should avoid alarming language. Kevin (Eng): perf/UX trade: live estimator calls the pricing service — debounce to 400ms. if offline show cached estimate and a small banner: "Estimates may be delayed". Also telemetry event: autoscale.change with fields: pool_id, min, max, burst_enabled. Priya (Accessibility): keyboard focus flow suggestion: Tab -> Pool Picker -> Min stepper -> Max stepper -> Burst pill -> SLO slider -> Details. If flyout opens, focus should jump to first control and return to Burst pill on close. Also add `aria-expanded` on the pill. Sam (Design): copy nits for guardrails: currently it says "Guardrail prevents extreme configs" — change to "Automatic guardrails limit risky configs to protect your SLOs and costs". shorter alt: "Guardrails protect your SLOs/costs". Which is clearer? Maya (PM): prefer the first one (slightly longer). we should also include a small "Why this?" link that opens a tooltip with examples. Kevin (Eng): edge case: what if user sets min very close to pool capacity and burst pushes over? UI should show inline validation: red text + tooltip suggesting alternative pools, and disable Apply until resolved. Also race with concurrent edits — server must return a diff and we should show "update conflict — refresh to reconcile". Liam (Data): for the SLO slider guardrail thresholds, propose we default to 99% for latency-sensitive tiers and 95% for background tasks. But allow org-level overrides. we should reflect that in the UI copy: "Default SLO per pool: 99% (latency)". Priya (Accessibility): final a11y request: add visible labels for icons, ensure the stepper buttons are at least 44x44px touch targets, and include `aria-label` on the cost estimator expand button. Sam (Design): I'll push an iteration: - swap modal -> flyout - add cost estimator under steppers - show patterned SLO state + icon - tweak guardrail copy. will post a new frame by EOD. :thumbsup: mockup-bot: new frame uploaded to figma (file v3.2) — Maya, Sam annotated the flyout behavior. Maya (PM): awesome — thanks everyone. next steps: Sam updates mocks, Kevin scopes server-side checks + debounce + telemetry, Priya signs off a11y checklist. I'll create a short ticket linking this thread. Kevin (Eng): noted. will add API validation rules and a unit test for the conflict case. Priya (Accessibility): will review final mockups and post checklist. thanks! :pray:
